test_title: PYST 26: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'BAKE' is coded as 'FDMF' and 'TURN' is coded as 'XXTO'. How will 'MOCK' be coded in the given language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'BAKE' is coded as 'FDMF'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5bdfa473f7fa57d2c5fae572e9876294a415eabb5bb427bc879555171e5211b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b408033a18eefdc055dda0b8fc05a56afaefe3dfbf17c0935831245d73877bd6.png] 

'TURN' is coded as 'XXTO'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cda2f5273560e4ab1f146c8b1ae92f5a65c598d3903da38b9800aeed2f8c4a31.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc72fa5ee928d2ec313bc939f99c2c713ce6b982a9db47934437c34ca2374369.png] 

Similarly, '**MOCK**' will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/411bb565ef668fede3aa9a1005e479b9053d9dce4f990d31a47813ec8fef2aa8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76408691b026f2112931714fb004a579827953499e50cd5366e5255a2fbfe5d5.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"QREL".**
